Only a later completed bar CLOSING below it sets nl1120_stop_confirmed; the shared exit_signal / up_exit then sell all at any stage after the -15% and expiry checks. The rev1 reference-low exit is ignored for marked positions and kept for older ones. New sell reasons must stay in the coin accept-list and decision-basis labels (a missing entry silently rejects the sale). MarketTrend entry: only the first completed bar after RSI<=30 closing above its Bollinger MIDDLE may buy; consumed cycles reset to READY only after RSI>30. Never creates quotes, orders or fills; the observer runs outside the order path (Upbit deep history fetched once per position).

One-time owner-authorised PAPER ledger reset of stock/coin AT, MA, MarketTrend and close-betting wallets; GMO files are never opened and 'gmo' can never be a target. Runs once per phone process before any engine starts (LedgerAntiRollbackV002.verify), after the witness was verified and before the guard check; backs up every touched wallet, reverses cash and realized P&L exactly per position, deletes position-linked rows via legacy_purge_v012 helpers, rebases the anti-rollback witness for the touched wallets only (any other ledger change aborts) and writes a DONE marker; a failure before the witness swap restores the wallets. REAL/broker-linked, unreconcilable or orphan rows are kept and reported (PARTIAL). Schemas, seeds, research/score journals and engine code are untouched. Java catches every failure so it can never block trading.

One-time clearing of INDEPENDENT research / error / AI history files only (AI_RESEARCH_V040, AI_COMPREHENSIVE_V052, phone_buy_evidence_v035, execution_decisions_v074, execution_entry_plans_v107, forward_high_v041, ANDROID_RESEARCH_OBSERVATIONS, MarketTrend RSI watch file; MarketTrend journal logs; issues/runtime_error_summary/issue_lifecycle of non-GMO DBs; non-GMO post-exit rows; *error*.jsonl; app fault log once). Never touches signals, candidates, pending, candidate_snapshots/forward/shadow (the engine back-fills snapshots from signals), bars, market score, accounts, MarketTrend latch/stop-reentry or any GMO file. Runs once per process before engines start, schema kept, per-database transactions, retried until every database succeeded, caught in Java so it never blocks trading.
